product.name: Upcar
product.oneLiner: There's a car parked near you.

audience: people who need a car, makers and early adopters on Product Hunt

beats.headline: There's a car parked near you.

vo.srtText: There's probably a car parked near you right now. We built Upcar so you can rent it from the neighbor who owns it.

beats.headline: Car rental still works like it's 2005.
beats.sub: We wanted it to feel as easy as booking a place to stay, so we built it.

vo.srtText: Renting a car still means a counter, a line, and fine print. We wanted it to feel as easy as booking a place to stay.

beats.headline: A car a few blocks away.

vo.srtText: Open Upcar, find a car from a local host a few blocks away, and book it in about two minutes.

cards.headline: A car a few blocks away
cards.body: Cars parked in your own neighborhood, not at an airport counter across town.

cards.headline: From real local hosts
cards.body: Every car is owned by a real person in your city who lists it themselves.

cards.headline: Insured every trip
cards.body: Coverage is included on every booking, start to finish.

vo.srtText: Cars in your neighborhood, from real local hosts, with insurance included on every trip. That's the whole idea.
We're live in five states today, and we're opening new cities every month.
One year in, six hundred local hosts have listed their cars, and renters have booked over a million dollars in trips.
Upcar is live. Find a car near you at upcar dot a-i. And if you're seeing us on Product Hunt today, we'd love your support.
